title: Introduction and overview — Toyota 2000GT (1967-1970)
description: Introduction and overview of the Toyota 2000GT (1967-1970): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Toyota 2000GT was Japan's first supercar, a Yamaha-engineered coupe with a 2.0-liter twin-cam inline-six. Only 351 were built, but the car proved Japanese engineering could match Europe's best and starred in the James Bond film You Only Live Twice. Examples now sell for over a million dollars. power_hp = 150
weight_lb = 2460
zero_sixty_s = 9.8
weight_kg = weight_lb * 0.453592
hp_per_tonne = power_hp / (weight_kg / 1000)
avg_accel = 26.8224 / zero_sixty_s  # 0-60 mph in m/s^2
print(f"Power-to-weight: {hp_per_tonne:.1f} hp per tonne")
print(f"Average 0-60 mph acceleration: {avg_accel:.2f} m/s^2")
demo.note: Working demonstration using the record's own figures.

title: Racing and motorsport heritage — Toyota 2000GT (1967-1970)
description: Racing and motorsport heritage of the Toyota 2000GT (1967-1970): Competition history and homologation specials. The Toyota 2000GT was Japan's first supercar, a Yamaha-engineered coupe with a 2.0-liter twin-cam inline-six. Only 351 were built, but the car proved Japanese engineering could match Europe's best and starred in the James Bond film You Only Live Twice. Examples now sell for over a million dollars.
